label: Studio Light
description: Controlled studio setups for portrait and product work.

items.name: softbox-key
items.text: large octagonal softbox as key light at 45 degrees, creamy highlight roll-off and soft defined shadows

items.name: rembrandt
items.text: classic Rembrandt lighting, key high and to the side leaving a triangle of light on the shadowed cheek

items.name: butterfly
items.text: butterfly lighting from high front, symmetrical glamour shadows under nose and chin

items.name: clamshell
items.text: clamshell beauty lighting, soft key above and fill below erasing texture, luminous even skin

items.name: rim-kicker
items.text: twin rim kickers from behind separating the subject with bright edge highlights

items.name: gelled-duotone
items.text: opposing gelled strobes, teal from one side and magenta from the other, saturated duotone modeling

items.name: hard-bare-flash
items.text: hard bare direct flash, crisp fashion-editorial shadows thrown flat on the backdrop

items.name: ring-light
items.text: frontal ring light, shadowless beauty illumination with a circular catchlight in the eyes

items.name: gridded-spot
items.text: a gridded spot picking the subject out of a black studio void, controlled spill

items.name: white-cyclorama
items.text: even high-key light on a seamless white cyclorama, floating shadowless product look

items.name: light-painting-sweep
items.text: long-exposure light-painting sweeps wrapping the subject in ribbons of controlled highlight

items.name: window-flag-negative
items.text: single soft window source with black negative fill deepening the shadow side, quiet cinematic contrast
